all_pair_invariant.literal_cost: k=2q+1, n=2q+2, m=4q+4, H2=n*k+q+2 (two input exposures and one final common query included), D_before_tail=2q.
all_pair_invariant.next_pair_encoder: b1+=U; later c_l-=next raw delta C and +=U; swap t with next c; t+=V; continue source N; u_next=V, v_next=-U-N*A_next
all_pair_invariant.two_handoff_exit: U=P_even*u; V=P_odd*(N*v-A_next); public b_r=N*b_rraw, c_r=N*delta C_r; b1=N*(b1raw+A_next)
